audit.why: Early through 6 is Akshan-favoured (850-range Q poke, Dirty Fighting shield, Heroic Swing mobility vs immobile Veigar); flips at first item (Rylai's slow pins the swing) and stays flipped. Matches 55.26% owner WR over 1160 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart had 'Skill' on rows 4-6 while content win[] reads Akshan/Veigar/Veigar and packet chart agrees.
audit.why: At 6 his Comeuppance execute plus swing mobility beat a cage he can dodge; from first item the slow/stacks invert it.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side to Akshan, phases[5-6].side to Veigar, whys rewritten in group.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers in breakdown.cooldowns; two copy-paste-bleed bullets; R-vs-R execute race (both ults scale off missing health) never stated.
audit.why: Kit gives Heroic Swing 18s scaling to 12s, Comeuppance 100s rank 1, Veigar E 20s rank 1; both ultimates are missing-health nukes so the sub-half race matters.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to breakdown.cooldowns; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d rewritten around the execute race.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: His Comeuppance executes a poked-down Veigar and Heroic Swing dodges the cage — you have R too, but he dictates 6.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Rylai's/Luden's spike: the slow pins his swing; cage-W-Q-R bursts his shield. Favour flips here.

edits.before: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: cage the choke, burst the carry, and let infinite AP write the closing statement.
edits.after: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: his dashes mean nothing inside the cage — burst him before the W shield matters.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Event Horizon (self-cage) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s at max — his engage AND escape; fight only while it is down. - His R Comeuppance runs 100s at rank 1. - Your E Event Horizon (20s rank 1) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. R for when it goes right.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Comeuppance is missing-health damage too — R him the instant he dips sub-half, before his own execute channel starts.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: At half HP his stored Comeuppance bullets read your bar as a countdown — no stack is worth a 2500-range execute walk-in.
